notes.title: Version 0.7.69 Update
notes.notes: [p]Bugs fixed:[/p][list][*][p]Purification Box Issue: Fixed the inability to exit by pressing "X" when fewer than 4 items are placed in the box.[/p][/*][*][p]Paper Doll Count Error: In the office building lobby, the number of paper dolls wrongly counted as 0 when 1 was left.[/p][/*][*][p]Menu Freeze Bug: Fixed the player being unable to move right after closing the menu due to Joe's shield skill.[/p][/*][/list][p]Optimization:[/p][list][*][p]Task Key Binding: Changed the "Alt" key function from "hold" to "click" for task activation.[/p][/*][*][p]Purification Box UI:[/p][p]  - Added error hints for invalid items placed in the box.[/p][p]  - Temporarily hides the ring and the coin when selecting the obsession items.[/p][/*][*][p]Sanity System:[/p][p]  - Significantly reduced sanity consumption from cursed items.[/p][p]  - Increased the quantity of sanity-restoring items in OMG mail attachments.[/p][/*][*][p]Workflow Improvements:[/p][p]  - Optimized the messages for interaction points during the "Retrieve ID card" process.[/p][p]  - Simplified the ID card usage procedure.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Version 0.7.68 Update
notes.notes: [p]Bug Fixed:[/p][list][*][p]In Jolin's room, Joe's defense against the Peachwood Sword fails to trigger the storyline.[/p][/*][*][p]The player can walk upward through the wall near the meeting room door.[/p][/*][*][p]After the purification, detection items remain usable.[/p][/*][/list][p]Optimizations:[/p][list][*][p]Revised the dialogue after failed Spirit Pad attempts, strengthening the connection between ghost reactions and questions.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the OMG email to clarify the descriptions of the Spirit Pad and Voodoo doll.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ✨9/22 Demo Launch
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,  [/p][p][/p][p]We are [b][i]Spicy Games[/i][/b], and [b][i]Ghost Hunting Journal[/i][/b] is our second story-driven adventure game.  [/p][p]On [b]September 22[/b], we will officially release the demo version of our game on Steam. Welcome to download and try it for free!  [/p][p][/p][p]The demo includes the complete first chapter of the game (estimated playtime: 1-1.5 hours). In [b][i]Ghost Hunting Journal[/i][/b], we aim to create a lighthearted and fun gameplay experience-in our game's world, even "ghost hunting" can be a scream-filled laughter:) [/p][p][/p][p]We are a small indie team of two person. Due to time and cost constraints, the demo may have areas that need improvement, and we will strive to continuously update and optimize it in future versions. We especially hope to hear more feedback from players through the demo to help us better improve the game.  [/p][p]You're more than welcome to reach us through the following channels: [/p][list][*][p]Leave a message in the Steam community [/p][/*][*][p]Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/JRuK5fZWNg[/p][/*][*][p]Email us to: Spicygames@163.com[/p][/*][*][p]Follow our X accounts: SpicyLao, Alexma823[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support, and if you are interested in our game, don't forget to wishlist to stay updated on the latest news-your support is our greatest motivation to keep creating! [/p][p][/p][p]--Spicy Games[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Test Recruitment NOW!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! [/p][p]Thank you for your support towards Spicy Games. [/p][p]Our new game, "[b]Ghost Hunting Journal[/b]" has been in development for some time, which is a story-driven adventure game. Before the official release of the demo, we are planning to conduct a small-scale closed beta test. We sincerely invite interested players to participate! Your valuable feedback will provide crucial assistance to our game (bows). [/p][p][/p][p]Below are the details for this test: [/p][p][b]Recruitment Period[/b]: [/p][p]September 8 ~ September 10 [/p][p][b]Information Collection:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Steam Account ID[/p][/*][*][p]Email address (for receiving relevant notifications)[/p][/*][*][p]Gender, age, and gaming preferences [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Test Time:[/b] [/p][p]Please refer to the email notification for the exact schedule. [/p][p][b]Test Content and Requirements:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]The test content covers Chapter 1 of the game, with an estimated playtime of 1 to 2 hours. [/p][/*][*][p]The test version may contain minor bugs and unfinished assets. Please report these to us, and if possible, retain and send relevant screenshots or recordings. [/p][/*][*][p]Participants are required to complete the entire test game at least once. We encourage players to try various atypical actions during the test. [/p][/*][*][p]After the test, participants need to complete a survey and a bug feedback form to help us improve the game. [/p][/*][*][p]This is a small-scale closed beta test, and recruitment will only be conducted through specific communities. Selected players are required to maintain confidentiality—no public sharing or selling of test codes is allowed. Please ensure the security and privacy of the test content. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]How to Apply:[/b] [/p][p]Option 1: Join our Discord: [b][url="https://discord.gg/JRuK5fZWNg"]https://discord.gg/JRuK5fZWNg[/url][/b] and leave a message including your Steam Account ID, email, gender, age, and gaming experience. [/p][p]Option 2: Send an email to [u][b]marcowill823@gmail.com[/b][/u] with your Steam Account ID, gender, age, and gaming experience. [/p][p][/p][p]We will select a number of players based on the applications and send Steam test codes via email. Please keep an eye on your inbox. [/p][p]Please note that the number of test spots is limited. We appreciate your understanding. [/p][p][/p][p]                                                                                                                                                Spicy Games[/p][p]                                                                                                                                      September 7, 2025 [/p][p][/p]
